subject: Command Post: KPI dashboard closure & QBR prep

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Matt Hartley <matt.hartley@acme.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.ai>, ClearWave Analytics <partner@clearwave.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Command Post: KPI dashboard closure & QBR prep

Team,

Attaching the latest QBR KPI dashboard (QBR_KPI_dashboard_v2.pdf) and the SLA exceptions export (SLA_exceptions_log.csv). High-level notes from the last dashboard run: 

- Latency (p95 per inference): +8% month-over-month, driven by a 22% increase in long-sequence requests from the analytics cohort.
- Cost (unit cost per 10k tokens): +12% vs plan — model mix shifted to larger variants; caching hit-rate fell to 41%.
- Uptime: 99.93% (within target) but saw two short region failovers on 6/10 and 6/18 that added ~18 minutes to total downtime this period.
- Usage: overall token volume +34%; top 5 customers account for 62% of increased traffic.

As we lock slides for the leadership readout, I need owners to confirm validated numbers and sign off on a one-page remediation plan for the latency and cost deltas. Proposed owners: 
- Latency root cause & runbook updates: Markus Klein
- Cost attribution & cache strategy: Jonas Weber
- Customer impact & SLA messaging: Irene Choi
- Slide deck finalization and QBR narrative: Laura Bennett

Suggested timeline: owners confirm slate by EOD Thursday (6/24), draft remediation slide by Monday (6/28). Optional 60-minute command post tomorrow at 10:00 PT to triage open questions — please RSVP.

Next steps in this thread: owners reply with brief acceptance, any numbers that need correction, and whether you want the external customers looped into an interim update.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_KPI_dashboard_v2.pdf (pdf, 3.2MB), SLA_exceptions_log.csv (csv, 120KB)

Thanks Vanessa — I confirm receipt and the high-level numbers look right to me. A couple of quick items: 

1) The SLA exceptions file shows two customer-facing incidents; one has an ongoing RCA that narrows down to a deploy that increased latency for long sequences. I'll assign a triage ticket and ask SRE to pin that deploy.
2) For messaging: if we share an interim note with the top affected customers, I recommend we keep it factual and offer a timeline for remediation rather than root-cause detail. Happy to draft.

Markus — can you validate the latency regression signal against the deployment timeline (6/9–6/11)? If it's correlated we may want a rollback decision tree documented in the runbook.

Irene
VP, Reliability & Security
Redwood Inference
